The '''rebel speeder''' was a model of [[starship]] that was active during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]] and was used by the [[Mining Guild]]. Several of these starships joined the [[Citizens' Fleet]] that was assembled by [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] to aid the Resistance against the [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] of the [[Sith Eternal]] during the [[Battle of Exegol]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

The vessel had a front starboard [[cockpit]] for the [[pilot]] and a port [[turret]]-mounted twin [[laser cannon]] towards the aft that was operated by a [[gunner]]. It was equipped with two frontal [[laser]] [[cannon]]s, two [[engine]]s, and a [[hyperdrive]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TROS_rebel_speeder_concept.png|thumb|left|200px|Concept art of the rebel speeder for Episode IX.]]
The rebel speeder was first seen in [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]<ref name="Episode IX" /> and identified as such in the clip, "A Final Alliance" behind the scenes featurette that comes with the [[Wikipedia:Target|Target]] exclusive of the home video.<ref name="io9">{{WebCite|url=https://io9.gizmodo.com/see-how-star-wars-most-impressive-fleet-was-created-in-1842223160|text=See How Star Wars' Most Impressive Fleet Was Created in This Exclusive Rise of Skywalker Clip|work=[https://io9.gizmodo.com Gizmodo]|date=2020-03-10|archivedate=20200311135740}}</ref>
